mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing paroxetine plasma concentrations, while both agents may have additive antiplatelet effects increasing bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for increased paroxetine side effects (nausea, sedation, hyponatremia); consider INR monitoring if patient on concurrent anticoagulants; counsel on bleeding precautions.
